filter.smart_filter_extras.items.name: Item List
filter.smart_filter_extras.items.tooltip: Matches any of the listed items (up to 256). Entries can be exact variants, e.g. one potion.
filter.smart_filter_extras.item_tag.name: Item Tags (multiple)
filter.smart_filter_extras.item_tag.tool: Matches items in any of the checked item tags (up to 64).
filter.smart_filter_extras.block_tag.too: Matches items whose placed block is in any of the checked block tags. Seeds place crops, so they match #minecraft:crops.
filter.smart_filter_extras.fuel.name: Fuel Value
filter.smart_filter_extras.fuel.tooltip: Compares the furnace burn time in ticks. >0 is any fuel, =0 is not a fuel. 200 ticks smelt one item.
